Exact visible error or confirmation that no error is displayed

diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The source system and observation time are recorded.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: Ask the reporter for an approximate timestamp and timezone.

diagnostic_steps.instruction: Check operational incident OPS-PM7-09 and compare its status and time window with the reported delay.
diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The incident record supplies a status as of a timestamp, a scheduled window, and any actual resolution time.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: Treat a stale or missing status as unconfirmed; check the operational incident owner/process.

diagnostic_steps.instruction: If a matching incident is currently active, retry after its confirmed recovery; if the delay persists outside the incident window, collect a fresh timestamp and escalate through the source-system support process.
diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The retry is made after confirmed recovery, or a new report is linked to an active incident.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: Do not treat a planned end time as confirmed recovery.

Check operational incident OPS-PM7-09 and compare its status and time window with the reported delay.

symptoms: The approval task TASK-LANG-25 is displayed in a language the employee did not request; the employee requested Spanish task content.
possible_causes: Scenario-based expected cause: Spanish is not supported for the source-system task content in this scenario. This does not describe the Unified Inbox interface language.
required_information: Affected task/workflow reference
Observation timestamp and timezone if relevant
Exact visible error or confirmation that no error is displayed

diagnostic_steps.instruction: Confirm source system HR ESS, task TASK-LANG-25, and the requested task-content language Spanish.
diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The source task and requested language are identified.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: Ask which language is requested and confirm whether the concern is task content or the Unified Inbox interface.

diagnostic_steps.instruction: Compare Spanish with the supported task-content language list for HR ESS; it is excluded in this scenario.
diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The catalogue provides the source-system task-content language list.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: If no source-system list is available, report the limitation and request source-system confirmation.

diagnostic_steps.instruction: Offer a language present in the supported list or refer the user to source-system support for an approved alternative.
diagnostic_steps.expected_observation: The user selects a documented supported task-content language or receives an approved support route.
diagnostic_steps.handling_when_unclear: Do not imply that changing the Unified Inbox UI language translates source-provided task content.

troubleshooting_steps: Confirm source system HR ESS, task TASK-LANG-25, and the requested task-content language Spanish.
Compare Spanish with the supported task-content language list for HR ESS; it is excluded in this scenario.
Offer a language present in the supported list or refer the user to source-system support for an approved alternative.
escalation_criteria: Escalate to source-system support if the source-system record or capability cannot be verified, or the issue persists after confirmed recovery.
known_limitations: Demonstration guidance only; not independently validated product procedure.
Retrieval is not diagnosis and does not verify user permissions.
